blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Logistics is part of a supply chain. It focuses on moving and storing things: raw materials, parts, and finished products. The supply chain covers the whole journey. Logistics is the engine that carries the goods from one place to another.

Good logistics is almost invisible. When it works, nobody notices. When it fails, everybody notices. A late delivery, a damaged box, or a missing pallet is easy to see.

If the supply chain is the plan, logistics is the movement that makes the plan real.

items.q: What does logistics focus on?
items.why: "It focuses on moving and storing things."

items.q: According to the text, when do people notice logistics?
items.why: "When it works, nobody notices. When it fails, everybody notices."

items.q: The text says the supply chain is the plan. What is logistics?
items.why: "If the supply chain is the plan, logistics is the movement."

items.q: A late delivery suggests that…
items.why: Inferência: um atraso é um sinal visível de que a logística falhou.

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: When logistics works, most people do not notice it.
Logistics is the same as the whole supply chain.
A damaged box is a logistics problem.
Logistics moves goods from place to place.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que a logística é só uma PARTE da cadeia, não a cadeia inteira.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicando logística a um novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team! Let me show you something real. This morning a truck left our warehouse. It carried three hundred boxes of finished product to a customer in the north.

People often ask me: what is logistics? It is simple. Logistics is the movement. It is how we carry the goods from here to the customer. We move things and we store things. That is the job. Nothing more, nothing less.

The supply chain is the big plan. It covers the whole journey, from raw materials to the shelf in the shop. But logistics is the engine. It is the part that makes the plan real. Without it, the plan is just paper.

Look at this shipment. If it arrives on time and nothing is damaged, nobody will notice. That is good logistics — it is invisible. But if the truck is late, or one box is broken, everybody will call me today. So we check every pallet before it leaves the door. Come with me now, and I will show you how we load the next truck.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What left the warehouse this morning?
options: A truck with three hundred boxes
items.why: "This morning a truck left our warehouse. It carried three hundred boxes."

items.q: How does James define logistics?
items.why: "Logistics is the movement. It is how we carry the goods."

items.q: What does James say the supply chain covers?
items.why: "The supply chain is the big plan. It covers the whole journey."

items.q: Why does James check every pallet before it leaves?
options: To avoid late or damaged shipments
items.why: Inferência: ele checa para que nada chegue atrasado ou danificado — senão todos ligam para ele.

items.q: What does James mean when he says good logistics is invisible?
options: When it works well, people do not notice it
items.why: Inferência: se tudo dá certo, ninguém repara — a logística só aparece quando falha.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We store the boxes in the warehouse until the truck comes." To store means to…
items.why: To store = armazenar, guardar em um lugar.

items.q: "Logistics is the engine of the supply chain." Here engine means…
options: the part that makes things move
items.why: Engine = motor: a parte que faz tudo se mover.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The box arrived ___, so we cannot sell the product inside."
items.why: Damaged = danificado; uma caixa danificada não pode ser vendida.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Trucks ___ the goods from the factory to the customer."
items.why: To carry = transportar; caminhões transportam as mercadorias.

items.q: "The whole supply chain starts with raw materials." A supply chain is…
options: the whole journey of a product
items.why: Supply chain = cadeia de suprimentos: toda a jornada do produto.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no trabalho de logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We will roll out the new delivery plan next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = começar a usar/implementar algo novo.

items.q: "The manager must sign off on the shipment before it leaves." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "The truck set off at six in the morning." To set off means to…
items.why: Set off = partir, começar uma viagem.

items.q: "Please keep track of every box in the truck." To keep track of means to…
options: follow and know where it is
items.why: Keep track of = acompanhar, saber onde algo está.

items.q: "The team always follows through on a delivery promise." To follow through means to…
items.why: Follow through = cumprir até o fim o que foi prometido.
